description: This file defines the CRServiceWorker class, a specialized worker for handling service workers in Chromium within the Playwright testing framework. It manages network interception, console messages, and session events related to service workers.

classes.name: CRServiceWorker
classes.description: A class extending Worker to manage Chromium service workers, including network interception, event handling, and communication with the browser context.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a CRServiceWorker instance, sets up event listeners, and manages network settings based on environment variables and browser version.

methods.name: didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the service worker is closed, removing session references.

methods.name: updateOffline
methods.description: Updates the offline status of the network manager based on browser context options.

methods.name: updateHttpCredentials
methods.description: Updates HTTP credentials for network requests.

methods.name: updateExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets extra HTTP headers for network requests.

methods.name: updateRequestInterception
methods.description: Configures request interception based on current settings.

methods.name: needsRequestInterception
methods.description: Determines if request interception is needed based on current options.

methods.name: reportRequestFinished
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a request has finished.

methods.name: requestFailed
methods.description: Emits an event when a request fails.

methods.name: requestReceivedResponse
methods.description: Emits an event when a response is received.

methods.name: requestStarted
methods.description: Emits an event when a request starts and handles request interception if applicable.

methods.name: _isNetworkInspectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if network inspection is enabled based on browser context options.
